lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa daras deejai jas gaavau nis ar bhor ||
lines.translation: Show Mercy to me, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. I sing Your Praises night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਇਹੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kes sa(n)g daas pag jhaarau ihai manorath mor ||1||
lines.translation: With my hair, I wash the feet of Your slave; this is my life's purpose. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੀਆ ਨ ਹੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaakur tujh bin beeaa na hor ||
lines.translation: O Lord and Master, without You, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਅਰਾਧਉ ਨਿਰਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਓਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: chit chitavau har rasan araadhau nirakhau tumaree or ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, in my mind I remain conscious of You; with my tongue I worship You, and with my eyes, I gaze upon You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaal purakh sarab ke thaakur binau karau kar jor ||
lines.translation: O Merciful Lord, O Lord and Master of all, with my palms pressed together I pray to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਉਧਰਸਿ ਆਖੀ ਫੋਰ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: naam japai naanak daas tumaro udharas aakhee phor ||2||11||20||
lines.translation: Nanak, Your slave, chants Your Name, and is redeemed in the twinkling of an eye. ||2||11||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲੋਕ ਅਰੁ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਆਈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਤੇ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: braham lok ar rudr lok aaee i(n)dr lok te dhaai ||
lines.translation: Overwhelming the realm of Brahma, the realm of Shiva and the realm of Indra, Maya has come running here.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਉ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kau johi na saakai mal mal dhovai paai ||1||
lines.translation: But she cannot touch the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; she washes and massages their feet. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab mohi aai pario saranaai ||
lines.translation: Now, I have come and entered the Lord's Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਹਜ ਪਾਵਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਜਾਰੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਓ ਹੈ ਬਤਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guhaj paavako bahut prajaarai mo kau satigur deeo hai bataai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This awful fire has burned so many; the True Guru has cautioned me about it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਰਹੀ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jakhy ki(n)nar nar rahee ka(n)th urajhaai ||
lines.translation: It clings to the necks of the Siddhas, and the seekers, the demi-gods, angels and mortals.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਐਸੀ ਦਾਸਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak a(n)g keeaa prabh karatai jaa kai kot aisee daasaai ||2||12||21||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has the support of God the Creator, who has millions of slaves like her. ||2||12||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਜਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: apajas mitai hovai jag keerat daragah baisan paaeeai ||
lines.translation: His bad reputation is erased, he is acclaimed all over the world, and he obtains a seat in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jam kee traas naas hoi khin mahi sukh anad setee ghar jaaeeai ||1||
lines.translation: The fear of death is removed in an instant, and he goes to the Lord's House in peace and bliss. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te ghaal na birathee jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: His works do not go in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar simarahu prabh apanaa man tan sadaa dhiaaeeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, remember your God in meditation; meditate on Him continually in your mind and body. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mohi saran deen dukh bha(n)jan too(n) dehi soee prabh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Destroyer of the pains of the poor; whatever You give me, God, that is what I receive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਹ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal naanak ra(n)g raate har daasah paij rakhaaeeai ||2||13||22||
lines.translation: Nanak is imbued with the love of Your lotus feet; O Lord, please preserve the honor of Your slave. ||2||13||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisva(n)bhar jeean ko daataa bhagat bhare bha(n)daar ||
lines.translation: The all-sustaining Lord is the Giver of all beings; His devotional worship is an overflowing treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਿਫਲ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਕਰੇ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kee sevaa niphal na hovat khin mahi kare udhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Service to Him is not wasted; in an instant, He emancipates. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere charan kamal sa(n)g raach ||
lines.translation: O my mind, immerse yourself in the Lord's lotus feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ਤਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਚੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal jee jaa kau aaraadhahi taahoo kau too(n) jaach ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Seek from Him, who is worshipped by all beings. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran tumhaaree karate too(n) prabh praan adhaar ||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, O Creator Lord; You, O God, are the support of my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: hoi sahaaee jis too(n) raakhahi tis kahaa kare sa(n)saar ||2||14||23||
lines.translation: He who is protected by You, O Helper Lord - what can the world do to him? ||2||14||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ਆਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kee paij savaaree aap ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself has protected the honor of His humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਵਖਧੁ ਉਤਰਿ ਗਇਓ ਸਭੁ ਤਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam deeo gur avakhadh utar gaio sabh taap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has given the medicine of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, and all afflictions are gone. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਰਖਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: harigobi(n)d rakhio paramesar apunee kirapaa dhaar ||
lines.translation: The Transcendent Lord, in His Mercy, has preserved Har Gobind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਟੀ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mitee biaadh sarab sukh hoe har gun sadaa beechaar ||1||
lines.translation: The disease is over, and there is joy all around; we ever contemplate the Glories of God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)geekaar keeo merai karatai gur poore kee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: My Creator Lord has made me His own; such is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਚਲ ਨੀਵ ਧਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: abichal neev dharee gur naanak nit nit chaRai savaaee ||2||15||24||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak laid the immovable foundation, which grows higher and higher each day. ||2||15||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੂਜਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: goojaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Goojaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚੀਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabahoo har siu cheet na laaio ||
lines.translation: You never focused your consciousness on the Lord.
